scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker independently constructs the dynamical matrix and diagonalises for each (A_prime, impurity) row, comparing agent's frequency against recomputed value within relative tolerance.

outputs.description: Localized vibrational mode frequencies for H⁻ and D⁻ impurities in a nine-atom CsCl-type defect cluster, as a function of the defect short-range parameter A'. The checker independently rebuilds the dynamical matrix for each row and compares the reported frequency to the recomputed value within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the highest triply-degenerate eigenvalue (localized mode) is scored. Perturbed lattice mode frequencies are not part of the scored output.

steps.description: Recompute localized mode frequencies for each row and compare with agent's reported frequency; fraction of rows within relative tolerance.
